findings.description: Explicit run selection accepted another operation; UUID tags were not normalized. Sync now verifies ownership and repeat identity.
Selected case IDs were accepted without actual result rows. Native rows now supply exact case/property identity and executed status.
Run dependency declarations were ignored. Native inventory/run identities and actual mounted source bytes/original surfaces now reconcile.
Known credential values escaped through field names and redaction reasons. Sanitized copies and reasons now omit them.

Missing required LLM context, wrong generation phase and unchecked effective-binding hash were possible. Existing typed binding/self digest and exact context identity are now validated; non-LLM distinction remains.
Duplicate native records inflated independent dispatch match count to2/1 despite incomplete status. Unique one-to-one matches now yield0/1 for that counterexample.
Duplicate action/flag keys silently chose the last value. Both native entrypoints use shared canonical decoding before dispatch.
